openFindings.title: Lifecycle Status match treats "incomplete" as "complete", `.opencode/skills/system-spec-kit/scripts/rules/check-ac-coverage.sh:66`, [Evidence: `[[ "$status" == *"complete"* ]]` is a glob on the whole Status table row after lowercasing. Edge-case prose wants mid-implementation measured, so this is over-accept rather than under-measure.]
